svg.title: From Existing Debt to Verified Retained Spread
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-subject-to-wrap-operating-loop; chart type: process_flow; title: From Existing Debt to Verified Retained Spread; subtitle: Five linked controls separate a performing wrap from an opaque payment promise.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Workflow order is operational, not a forecast of five completed transactions. First-deal timing remains 2–6 months. Property value, loan principal, escrow deposits, and pass-through debt service are excluded from canonical operator revenue.; caption: The operator acquires subject to existing debt without assuming that the original borrower has been released. A wrap adds a separate buyer obligation; it does not remove the senior lien.; stages: label: Source low-equity debt situations; value: Match seller needs with verified existing debt; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Use county recorder filings, foreclosure notices, and authorized seller records to identify low-equity situations. Confirm seller objectives, arrears, occupancy, and equity before pricing the existing rate advantage.; label: Underwrite title and acceleration; value: Price senior-lien exposure before making commitments; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Obtain title work, mortgage statements, reinstatement figures, insurance terms, and the actual security instrument. Model lender acceleration under 12 U.S.C. §1701j-3 and reject transactions without a funded response.; label: Qualify the wrap buyer; value: Route every owner-occupant buyer through licensed origination; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Have the licensed RMLO document income, assets, debts, credit obligations, and repayment capacity. Apply 12 CFR §1026.43 where covered and document the treatment of taxes, insurance, balloon terms, and payment changes.; label: Close with transparent payment routing; value: Execute recorded instruments and configure licensed servicing; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Counsel and title professionals coordinate deed, wrap note, security instrument, notices, and lien priority. The licensed servicer establishes borrower autopay, underlying-payment routing, escrow handling, and reporting.; label: Reconcile and manage exceptions; value: Verify underlying payments before releasing retained cash; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Reconcile the wrap ledger, underlying lender statement, bank settlement, tax account, and insurance evidence monthly. Escalate missing payments immediately; borrower autopay success alone does not prove senior-debt payment.
